name: Hon Thom Cable Car
kicker: Over-sea cable car to Hòn Thơm
summary: Over-sea cable car: ride about 15 minutes from Sunset Town to Hòn Thơm for the south-island view. From 1 January 2026 the return ticket is 850,000 đồng above 1.4 m. An earlier fare is 650,000 đồng for an adult. The system is 7,899.9 m, and the crossing is also about 13 km. The bridge and the show sit outside the ticket.
getThere: About 31 km from Dương Đông, at Bãi Đất Đỏ
heroCaption: A cabin on the Hòn Thơm cable car, over the islets and the turquoise water

notice.title: Bridge and show are extra
notice.body: From 1 January 2026 the return ticket includes one same-day entry to Sun World Hon Thom, Làng Exotica, and Aquatopia. It does not include food, lodging, paid beach activities, Cầu Hôn, or the Kiss of the Sea show.

body: Ride from ga Ánh Dương at Thị trấn Hoàng Hôn to ga Hòn Thơm. The system is 7,899.9 m and the ride is 15 minutes. The crossing is also about 13 km over the sea. It is one of the world’s longest over-sea cable cars, over fishing villages and islets. The station is at Bãi Đất Đỏ, about 31 km from thị trấn Dương Đông and about 21 km from the airport.

From 1 January 2026 the return ticket is 850,000 đồng above 1.4 m, 700,000 đồng from 1 m to 1.4 m, and free under 1 m, with runs at 09:30–11:30, 13:30–14:00, and 15:30–17:30, both ways. A fare in force from 9 December 2023 is 650,000 đồng for an adult and 500,000 đồng for a child, free under 1 m, with hours 9:00–11:30 and 13:30–17:00. Weather and maintenance can change the runs. The 2026 ticket includes one same-day entry to the park, Làng Exotica, and Aquatopia. Cầu Hôn and Kiss of the Sea are paid extras.

figures.caption: The cable over the An Thới shore, with the fishing boats below
figures.alt: Hon Thom cable car cabin and pylon above fishing boats at An Thoi

gettingThere: Ga Ánh Dương is at Thị trấn Hoàng Hôn, on Bãi Đất Đỏ, about 31 km from thị trấn Dương Đông and about 21 km from the airport. Ride south by motorbike, taxi, or minibus. The prison in An Thới is about 30 km southeast of Dương Đông, so the cable car and the relic share the south road.

legs.heading: From Dương Đông
legs.body: About 31 km south to ga Ánh Dương at Sunset Town. The ride itself is 15 minutes.

legs.heading: From the airport
legs.body: About 21 km to the station. Sun Group has operated Phu Quoc International Airport, in Duong To, since 1 January 2026.

closed: Weather and maintenance can change the runs. Hours in force from 9 December 2023 were 9:00–11:30 and 13:30–17:00.
admissionNote: From 1 January 2026, return ticket 850,000 đồng above 1.4 m, 700,000 đồng from 1 m to 1.4 m, free under 1 m. From 9 December 2023 the fare is 650,000 đồng for an adult, 500,000 đồng for a child, and free under 1 m. The 2026 ticket includes the round trip and one same-day entry to Sun World Hon Thom, Làng Exotica, and Aquatopia. Food, lodging, diving, walking under the sea, Cầu Hôn, and Kiss of the Sea are extra.
